pins.title: Icy trail, cold toes? Fix both.
pins.pinTitle: Winter hiking kit: chain ice cleats and merino wool socks for icy trails and cold feet
pins.description: Grip and warmth in one order: a pair of stainless steel chain ice cleats that stretch over your boots (about US women's 4 to US men's 11) and a pair of cushioned 80% merino wool crew socks in your color and size. $39.99 instead of $46.98 separately. For icy trailheads and packed snow, not steep ice. Gear ships in 6-13 business days.

pins.title: Cold feet in bed?
pins.sub: Soft merino socks for winter nights.
pins.pinTitle: Warm merino wool socks for cold nights at home: soft crew socks for reading in bed and lazy evenings
pins.description: Cold sheets and cold toes on a winter night: our cushioned merino wool crew socks (80% merino) stay soft and warm and breathe so feet don't get clammy. Four colors, for home, work, travel and the trail.

pins.title: Snow chores, warm feet.
pins.pinTitle: Merino wool socks for winter chores: warm feet for shoveling snow, firewood runs and frosty mornings
pins.description: Firewood, shoveling and early walks in the snow: cushioned 80% merino wool crew socks keep feet warm in boots, stay comfortable when damp and resist odor through a long day. Four colors, two sizes (about US men's 4-11 / women's 6-12).

pins.title: Collect every park you visit
pins.sub: A gift for park stamp collectors.
pins.board: Best Day Hikes in US National Parks
pins.pinTitle: Parks passport printable gift: state parks passport and all 64 US national parks tracker
pins.description: A small gift for someone who collects park stamps: our State Parks Passport (all 50 states and Canada's provinces) plus the US National Parks Tracker with all 64 parks, each with an easy day hike and a stamp box. $8.99 for both, instant PDF download in US Letter and A4, so it arrives in time for any holiday.

pins.title: Dark walks? Make your dog glow.
pins.pinTitle: LED dog collar for winter night walks: USB rechargeable light-up collar, 3 modes, XS to XXL
pins.description: In winter many dog walks happen in the dark. This light-up nylon collar glows all the way around, so you and drivers can see your dog at the park or the trailhead. Steady, slow flash and fast flash, USB charging, six sizes and seven colors. Fine in rain, not for swimming.

pins.title: Hiking at 50°F? Wear this.
pins.sub: Light layers, a shell for stops.
pins.pinTitle: What to wear hiking in 50 degree weather: light base layer, light fleece and a wind shell
pins.description: What to wear hiking at 50°F (10°C): a light long-sleeve base layer, hiking pants and wool socks, with a light fleece and a wind or rain shell to add at stops. What changes with sun, wind or rain, and what to carry in your pack.

pins.title: Dark by five? Hike lit and seen.
pins.pinTitle: After dark hiking set: rechargeable motion-sensor headlamp and LED reflective vest for short days
pins.description: In November the light goes early and the last mile is often a road walk back to the car. A USB-C motion-sensor headlamp lights the trail, and a neon green vest with red LED lights front and back helps drivers see you. $35.99 as a set. Gear ships in 6-13 business days.

pins.title: Joshua Tree, done right
pins.sub: Water, hikes and where to stay.
pins.board: Best Day Hikes in US National Parks
pins.pinTitle: Joshua Tree National Park trip planner printable: 1-3 day itineraries, 12 day hikes, campgrounds
pins.description: Plan a first trip to Joshua Tree: when to go (October to April), the three entrances, campgrounds, where to stay, 1, 2 and 3-day plans and 12 day hikes from Cholla Cactus Garden to Lost Palms Oasis. There is no water inside the park, so the guide includes a water-carry worksheet. 30-page PDF.

pins.title: Your 2027 hiking year starts here
pins.pinTitle: 2027 hiking planner printable: hike a week challenge, miles hiked tracker and hiking goals
pins.description: Set your hiking goals for 2027: a printable year planner with a hike-a-week challenge, a miles hiked tracker and goal pages. An easy stocking stuffer for a hiker, as an instant PDF download.

pins.title: Lost on the trail? Stop first.
pins.sub: A pocket plan you can print.
pins.pinTitle: What to do if you get lost hiking: printable guide and pocket card with the steps to stay safe
pins.description: If you lose the trail, stop, stay calm and think before you move. Our printable guide and pocket card cover what to do if you get lost hiking, how to signal for help and what to carry. Instant PDF download.
